risks: The pinned Q4_K_M GGUF (~67.2 GiB) and llama.cpp inference are not a trainable Leanstral checkpoint. BF16 119B weights are ~222 GiB; full fine-tuning with gradients and optimizer state is disabled and does not fit two 24 GiB RTX 3090s and ~126 GiB RAM under swap pressure. A community quantization checksum is not official-weight equality or a QLoRA backend.

Starting an adapter before frozen Leanstral and the CPU sparse encoder show a bottleneck versus a matched lexical baseline confuses reconstruction loss, teacher-selected edits, or model text with verified shortening. Missing pins, Lake or toolchain failures, and memory guards are infrastructure outcomes, not semantic negatives.

A later 1-3B LoRA can still change the proposition: statement, binders, universes, imports, axioms, or an executable definition without a proved equivalence. Family aliases, dependency overlap, or version-near duplicates can leak a sealed holdout and fabricate a gain.
actions: Keep full 119B fine-tuning disabled and do not train from GGUF. Inference authorization is not a trainable-weight receipt. A later optional adapter is only a licensed framework-compatible 1-3B base with real training weights: LoRA rank 8, alpha 16, dropout 0.05, sequence 512, batch 1, accumulation 8.

Require measured frozen-model and CPU-encoder results first. Compare a lexical baseline at equal retrieval and compiler budgets and count only the encoder ranking, not the teacher edit. Then a five-minute memory smoke on one 3090, retaining at least 16 GiB host RAM, then at most 100 steps and 1800 seconds before freezing one checkpoint. No automatic training.

Preserve statement, binders, universes, target identity, imports, namespace, and source prefix. Proof irrelevance covers a shorter proof of an unchanged proposition only; an executable-definition change needs a proved equivalence plus caller and runtime checks. Reject sorry, admit, and new axioms. Split by family, alias, dependency, and project; seal holdout before any fit. Stop at the task budget and record failures without inventing a fit or native receipt.
acceptance_boundaries: Design review only: no adapter code, weight load, fit, or Lean check. Actual tests and Lean compilation are separate evidence and are not claimed. No training, model promotion, competition submission, or git push is authorized.

Promotion needs a compatible trainable checkpoint, a passed memory smoke, and a frozen holdout gain in verified token reduction or accepted-candidate efficiency at matched budgets versus the lexical and CPU-encoder baselines, across disjoint families, with all-pin checks. A neutral or missing result keeps the simpler system. Full 119B training stays disabled.

Unresolved pins stay in the corpus denominator. Length-first, strict-dual, and official score stay separately named. Environment failures stay out of training labels. Cache identity follows source bytes, pins, and producer hashes from JLR-012. Heartbeats are not token length.
